debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log only to syslog.

log_level.description: Logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

state_path.description: Base directory for Octavia state and runtime files.

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to handle incoming requests.

driver_name.description: Backend driver module for load balancer management (e.g., amphora, provider_driver).

controller_endpoint.description: HTTP(S) endpoint URL of the Octavia controller API.

controller_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify the Octavia controller's TLS certificate.

client_cert.description: Path to the client certificate used for mutual TLS with the controller.

client_key.description: Path to the private key corresponding to the client certificate.

controller_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for responses from the Octavia controller.

amphora_periodic_health_check_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between health checks of amphorae.

max_loadbalancers_per_amphora.description: Maximum number of load balancers allowed per amphora instance.

failover_enabled.description: Enable automatic failover to a standby amphora if active amphora becomes unhealthy.

items.description: Supported load balancer topology (SINGLE or ACTIVE_STANDBY).

loadbalancer_topologies.description: List of enabled load balancer topologies supported by this agent.

items.description: Name of a provider driver (used when driver_name=provider_driver).

provider_drivers.description: List of registered provider driver names to load.

ip.description: Management IP address of the amphora.

compute_id.description: Nova compute instance ID for the amphora.

vrrp_ip.description: VRRP IP used for high availability failover.

ha_ip.description: HA IP used for communication between amphorae in ACTIVE_STANDBY topology.

amphorae.description: List of pre-registered amphorae to manage (optional, for static deployments).

transport_url.description: Message bus transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ, Redis, etc.).

rpc_topic.description: RPC topic used to send messages to and from the Octavia controller.

rpc_response_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for RPC responses before considering request failed.

health_driver.description: Health manager backend driver (e.g., health_master, health_backup).

health_manager_enabled.description: Enable the health manager subprocess for amphora health monitoring.

health_check_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between health syncs to amphorae.

health_manager_socket.description: Unix domain socket path used by the health manager for IPC.
